message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the appropriate charge(s) based on facts. The facts: Zhao stole a bag with phone, cash, ID; stole a gold necklace; stole another gold necklace and pendant. This is robbery (抢夺) i.e., theft with violence or intimidation? The description: "趁被害人不备，抢走" - that is snatching, i.e., robbery? In Chinese criminal law, "抢夺" is a form of theft (盗窃) but with force? Actually "抢夺" is a type of theft (抢夺罪) but often classified under theft (盗窃) in the list. The list includes "盗窃". So charge is theft/robbery. The list does not have a separate "抢夺" label, so we use "盗窃". Also there is mention of prior conviction and recidivism, but no other crimes. So answer: [罪名]盗窃<eoa>.
